text.keyword_delta_note: Stored. `dropped` names keywords the superseded memory carried and this one does not, so nothing answers to them here any more unless another memory happens to carry them. That is a legitimate act -- it is the only way to retire a keyword, since amendment is refused after export -- and it is reported because it is also what an incomplete re-typing looks like. If a dropped term should still find this memory, correct it now with hoard_correct's amend, which replaces the whole keyword array.
text.link_delta_note: Stored. `left_behind` names links the superseded memory carries and this one does not restate. A link is the claim of the memory that wrote it, so these stay with the superseded memory rather than becoming this one's. That is a legitimate act -- it is how a link that no longer holds is dropped -- and it is reported because it is also what an incomplete re-typing looks like. If one still holds for this memory, correct it now with hoard_correct's amend, which replaces the whole link array.
